mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate rise above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 1-month declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) by >0.5% indicate contraction in consumer demand and manufacturing output, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 0.5% and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline >0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.0% annualized), increased cost of capital reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >50% of instances where INDPRO increases over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 550.0 (thousands of units) in a month signals weak consumer demand for housing, reducing construction activity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where HOUST falls below 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 1-month rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) >0.2pp and decline in employment (PAYEMS) >0.5% indicate sharp labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls as per trigger.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below the 3-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances where RSAFS falls below 3-month moving average during late-cycle expansion.
